== Brandon’s Crisis of Faith Ba Da Da Dumm! ==
Brandon: So I feel like what I need in my life is to be more focused and disciplined and ‘planful’.  I don’t need more demands to do that; I need something that helps me be that and I don’t feel that I am getting it from SolSeed.  I am not sure that I can get it from anywhere but I am disappointed and resentful that SolSeed is not giving it to me like a magic bullet.  And all of my highest aspirations come to naught if I waste all my heartbeats.
* Ben: It is interesting that you, who read a lot of books, ''Switch'' for instance, that talk about how to motivate people and change things, are the one who has the most trouble with this of us.
* Eric: Tell me if there's any way I can help!  I'm your friend and I want you to feel good.
